description: A member-facing 案内/伴走 session for a single procedure (ADR-2605312030 §3, `toritsugi_intake` + `toritsugi_guide`). Holds the step-by-step walkthrough state + 必要書類 checklist pulled from a chigiri template (G5 — guidance, never 作成代理 or legal advice). CONSTITUTIONAL: member-initiated + consent + DID/SBT bound, OWN procedure only (G3); the member is the named 申請者本人 (G4); cites the procedure's legalBasis (G8). Holds session metadata + checklist state, not plaintext member PII (G6).

memberDid.description: The consenting member's DID (G3); the 申請者本人 (G4)

procedureRef.description: AT-URI / rkey of the toritsugi.procedure being walked through

templateRef.description: chigiri procedure-template id this guide renders (G5 boundary)

checklist.description: 必要書類 / step checklist state

consentRef.description: Reference to the member's recorded consent (G3)

checklistEntry.description: One 必要書類 / step checklist item in a procedureGuide session
